cases.html: x

a.svg.text: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='30' height='20'><rect width='30' height='20' fill='red'/></svg>

b.svg.text: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='30' height='20'><rect width='30' height='20' fill='red'/></svg>

c.svg.text: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='30' height='20'><rect width='30' height='20' fill='red'/></svg>

measure.js: (() => { const a = new Image(); watch(a, 'a'); L('init', img(a)); a.src = 'a.svg'; L('set', img(a)); const b = new Image(); watch(b, 'b'); b.src = 'badslow.png'; const c = new Image(); watch(c, 'c'); c.src = 'missslow.png'; return done(1000); })()

(() => { const a = new Image(); L('empty', img(a)); const b = new Image(); watch(b, 'b'); b.src = ''; L('src-empty', img(b)); const c = new Image(); watch(c, 'c'); c.setAttribute('src', 'a.svg'); c.removeAttribute('src'); L('removed', img(c)); const d = new Image(); watch(d, 'd'); d.src = 'data:image/svg+xml,' + encodeURIComponent("<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='5' height='7'/>"); L('data', img(d)); return done(); })()
(() => { const a = new Image(); watch(a, 'a'); a.src = 'b.svg'; a.src = 'c.svg'; return done(1200); })()

(() => { const a = new Image(); watch(a, 'a'); a.src = 'a.svg'; let n = 0; return new Promise(r => a.onload = () => { L('onload'); if (n++ === 0) { a.src = 'a.svg'; L('same', img(a)); setTimeout(() => r(log.splice(0)), 300); } }); })()
(() => { const a = new Image(); a.onload = () => L('onload'); a.onerror = () => L('onerror'); a.addEventListener('load', () => L('listener')); a.src = 'a.svg'; return done(); })()
(() => { const a = new Image(); watch(a, 'a'); a.src = 'a.svg'; return a.decode().then(() => { L('decoded', img(a)); return log.splice(0); }, e => e.name + ': ' + e.message); })()
(() => { const a = new Image(); a.src = 'bad.png'; return a.decode().then(() => 'ok', e => e.name + ': ' + e.message); })()
(() => { const a = document.createElement('img'); watch(a, 'a'); a.src = 'a.svg'; return done(); })()
(() => { const a = document.createElement('img'); watch(a, 'a'); a.src = 'a.svg'; document.body.appendChild(a); return done().then(r => { a.remove(); return r; }); })()
(() => { const a = document.createElement('img'); watch(a, 'a'); a.srcset = 'a.svg 1x'; L('srcset', img(a)); return done(); })()
(() => { const out = []; const a = new Image(); out.push(Object.getOwnPropertyNames(HTMLImageElement.prototype).join()); return out; })()

measure.js: (() => { const l = document.createElement('link'); l.rel = 'stylesheet'; watch(l, 'l'); l.href = 's.css'; document.head.appendChild(l); L('appended', !!l.sheet); return done().then(r => r.concat(['sheet:' + !!l.sheet])); })()

(() => { const l = document.createElement('link'); l.rel = 'stylesheet'; watch(l, 'l'); l.href = 'bad.css'; document.head.appendChild(l); return done().then(r => r.concat(['sheet:' + !!l.sheet])); })()

(() => { const l = document.createElement('link'); l.rel = 'stylesheet'; watch(l, 'l'); l.href = 'nocss.css'; document.head.appendChild(l); return done().then(r => r.concat(['sheet:' + !!l.sheet])); })()

(() => { const l = document.createElement('link'); l.rel = 'stylesheet'; watch(l, 'l'); l.href = 's2.css'; document.head.appendChild(l); l.href = 's.css'; return done().then(r => r.concat(['sheet:' + (l.sheet && l.sheet.href.split('/').pop())])); })()
(() => { const l = document.createElement('link'); l.rel = 'stylesheet'; watch(l, 'l'); l.href = 's.css'; return done(300).then(r => r.concat(['detached', !!l.sheet])); })()

(() => { const l = document.createElement('link'); watch(l, 'l'); l.href = 's.css'; document.head.appendChild(l); L('no-rel'); l.rel = 'stylesheet'; return done().then(r => r.concat(['sheet:' + !!l.sheet])); })()

(() => { const l = document.createElement('link'); l.rel = 'stylesheet'; watch(l, 'l'); l.href = 's.css'; document.head.appendChild(l); l.remove(); return done().then(r => r.concat(['sheet:' + !!l.sheet])); })()
(() => { const l = document.createElement('link'); l.rel = 'preload'; l.as = 'image'; watch(l, 'l'); l.href = 'a.svg'; document.head.appendChild(l); return done().then(r => r.concat(['x'])); })()
